changelogItems: Clicking the behemoth of a trial now filters the Trials list on it (from the Last Trials of the Dashboard or from the Trials list)
Renamed "Titles" to "Top 1s" in the Gauntlet champions statistic

New Reforged era (December 3, 2020, week 73): Trials are now split into Pre-Reforged (weeks 1 to 72), Reforged (weeks 73 to 281) and Awakening (week 282 and after, formerly Post-Awakening) in the settings, the era selector and the statistics filters
The era selector (Players, Player, Trials and Statistics pages) now turns each era on or off, like the settings
Renamed the "Hall of fame" statistic to "Top players" to avoid confusion with the community's Dauntless Hall of Fame
Added a link to the Dauntless Hall of Fame Discord on the Dashboard, in the menu, on the Top players statistic and on the About page
Added an era selector (All, Pre-Awakening, Post-Awakening) on the Players, Player and Trials pages, synced with the settings
Added a Pre-Awakening / Post-Awakening badge on Trial pages
Your player and guild are now always in your favorites
Added a Favorites page (top right menu) to see and remove your favorite players and guilds
Added a "Favorites only" filter on the Guilds, Players and Statistics pages (also in the settings)
New app icon
The website is now available in English, French, German, Japanese, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian (language picker in the header and in the settings, browser language by default)
Translations are made with AI for now: want to help? Every language file can be edited without coding (see "Help translate" in the language menu)
Dates and numbers now follow the selected language
Fixed Dashboard horizontal scroll on mobile devices
Complete redesign of the website: new look, new navigation and improved dark & light themes
Added a Statistics page: weapon & omnicell meta, loadouts, group compositions, behemoth records, photo finishes, top players, platforms and Gauntlet history, all with filters
Added stats on guild pages: best & average rank, top 10 streak, ranking among all guilds, rank by season chart and level per season
Added a stats summary on player pages: trials played, wins, best solo rank, main weapon and omnicell
Activity Rating replaced by Guild Score: a fairer formula where every ranked guild gets a score (hover the info icon for details)
